Solving for today's challenges

A healthy facility starts from the ground up

Our robots are always on the job, meticulously cleaning your facility. The result? Elevated cleanliness levels that never drop, creating a safe and healthy environment for employees and visitors.

Don't let labor issues slow you down

Move past the negative effects of hiring and retaining labor with cleaning automation. With our robots on your team, you’re never left shorthanded.

A clean you can measure is a clean you can improve

Highly detailed cleaning data gives you newfound insights into your facility. Our robots’ intuitive web-based app lets you monitor, manage, and measure your way to a smarter and more efficient clean.

Advanced robotics.
Advanced cleaning.

When only the highest cleaning quality standards are acceptable, our robots' proven reliability and durability ensure your facility stays clean.

Rugged construction, extended runtime, separate cleaning solution and recovery tanks — you can rely on Avidbots’ solutions to deliver a cleaner, more productive facility.

The best autonomous clean in the industry

Avidbots Autonomy provides an advanced suite of features

Menu
Advanced dynamic planning Real-time obstacle avoidance Intervention-free operation A 360° view of the environment

Powered by Avidbots Autonomy, our proprietary AI software, our robots deliver a fully autonomous clean while handling environment changes with ease. When you choose our robots, your facility is mapped and a cleaning plan is generated.

From that point forward, the robot’s onboard sensor suite examines the space at the beginning of each cleaning, comparing what it looks like in real time versus the original cleaning plan. The robot then determines the best cleaning route to maximize cleaning productivity while minimizing human intervention every time.

Neo, Neo 2W, and Kas are unmatched in obstacle avoidance. Using a variety of sensors, Avidbots Autonomy consistently evaluates real-time incoming data to help our robots avoid anyone or anything and stop when unexpected obstacles appear, helping to keep the operating environment safe.

Every time you press 'go', you can rest assured our robots will do just that. Thanks to Avidbots Autonomy, detailed cleaning plans, and real-time obstacle avoidance, our robots ensure intervention-free operation. In rare instances where the robot requires additional guidance, the Avidbots Remote Assistance team assists you with getting back on track using real-time data from the onboard sensors.

An industry-leading suite of lidar (light detection and ranging) and 3D sensors provide Avidbots Autonomy with a 360° view of its surroundings. With this constant stream of information and data, our robots make real-time safety and navigational decisions.
